401000001.title: Clemson enters Durham on short rest
401000001.author: Fixture Reporter
401000001.content: Clemson played on Saturday night and traveled to Durham on Sunday before facing Duke. The Tigers have logged heavy minutes from their starting five over the last two weeks. Duke has been at home for five consecutive days and has had a full practice cycle. Historically, short-turnaround road teams in conference play convert a lower share of close games.

401000001.title: Recent form favors Duke at home
401000001.author: Fixture Reporter
401000001.content: Duke's adjusted efficiency margin has climbed over its last four games. Clemson's offense has slowed in true road environments, and its turnover rate rises against top-40 defenses. The matchup profile points to a slower game with fewer transition opportunities for the underdog.

401000002.title: Kansas hosts TCU after quick turnaround
401000002.author: Fixture Reporter
401000002.content: Kansas returns home after a road trip and faces a TCU team that has been effective in transition. The Jayhawks are favored, but the pregame report notes a short preparation window and a possible look-ahead spot before a weekend rivalry game.

401000002.title: TCU stuns Kansas in Lawrence
401000002.author: Fixture Reporter
401000002.content: TCU closed the game on a decisive run and handed Kansas a home loss. This recap describes the final possession and postgame comments from both coaches.
